name: Explain earth science concepts and phenomena
description: Users asked for detailed explanations, definitions, and analyses of topics in earth sciences, including geology, meteorology, oceanography, and atmospheric physics. The requests covered specific phenomena such as plate tectonics, weather systems, and rock formation, as well as broader concepts like climate change and the structure of the Earth.
